outcome.answer: Zichao Wei’s work connects structural generalization to computational complexity in two ways. One paper argues that, under the assumption TC⁰ ≠ NC¹, pure Transformers cannot learn structural generalization because the relevant tree-evaluation problem is NC¹-complete, while their learnable class is contained in TC⁰ [1]. Another presents a neural cellular automaton that learns compositional rules from data without hand-written rules and evaluates its structural generalization on SLOG [2].
